highlights: Today keeps its order: while you log, skip or come back to the app, the Needs-care sections stay where they were when you opened Today. Tap By location or By type (even the one already highlighted) to re-sort. A new day starts fresh, and yesterday's logs no longer hide plants that are due again today.

Frost: once both forecasts for tonight warm out of frost range after a frost email, Today says "Forecast warmed to 44°F since the 3 PM frost email." instead of still warning of a freeze, after an advisory-only email too.
Behind the scenes: a bad release can now be undone by a normal follow-up release that keeps all your garden data, and the emergency rewind refuses to go back past 4.156.
